l4_steps.name: Import scheduled movements & gate inventory
l4_steps.input: SSIM schedule export, airport gate inventory with wingspan & equipment constraints
l4_steps.output: Flight movement list with time windows loaded into AMS
l4_steps.kpi: Gate plan build initiated ≥18h before day of operations; 100% of scheduled movements imported
l4_steps.pain_point: Late schedule amendments from airline ops (within T-6h) invalidate pre-built plans; no automated re-trigger of optimisation on change

l4_steps.name: Execute automated gate assignment optimisation
l4_steps.input: Flight movement list, terminal zone rules, contact-stand preference list
l4_steps.output: Draft gate assignment plan covering all scheduled movements
l4_steps.kpi: ≥92% of flights auto-assigned without manual intervention; optimisation run time <10 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Wide-body/narrow-body gate incompatibility not always captured in AMS master data — results in invalid auto-assignments requiring manual correction

l4_steps.name: Validate assignments against aircraft type constraints
l4_steps.input: Draft gate assignment plan, aircraft type per flight leg from PSS
l4_steps.output: Validated gate assignment list; flagged mismatches routed for manual resolution
l4_steps.kpi: 0 gate/aircraft-type mismatches published; validation complete ≥14h before operations day
l4_steps.pain_point: Ad-hoc aircraft swaps driven by AOG maintenance events are not always reflected in Amadeus Altéa PSS in time for gate validation cycle

l4_steps.name: Coordinate gate pre-conditioning with terminal ops
l4_steps.input: Validated gate plan, cleaning and catering subcontractor schedules
l4_steps.output: Confirmed gate readiness schedule aligned with ground handler SLAs
l4_steps.kpi: Gate confirmed ready ≥30 min before scheduled arrival; pre-conditioning exceptions <5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Cleaning and catering subcontractor SLA gaps at high-frequency turn stations cause gate hold-backs; A-CDM milestones not enforced contractually at all airports

l4_steps.name: Publish gate plan to FIDS and stakeholder systems
l4_steps.output: Gate assignments published to passenger displays, ground handler portals, and crew bus scheduler
l4_steps.kpi: Published ≥12h before day of operations; 100% of gates reflected in FIDS within 90 seconds of publish
l4_steps.pain_point: SITA FIDS update latency (up to 90s per change batch) causes passenger confusion during rapid same-day gate changes at high-traffic terminals

l4_steps.name: Ingest real-time flight status via ACARS
l4_steps.input: ACARS block-off/estimated arrival messages, ATC slot data, weather NOTAMs
l4_steps.output: Updated ETA per inbound flight refreshed in AMS every 5 minutes
l4_steps.kpi: ETA refresh cycle ≤5 min; ETA data completeness ≥97% of active flights
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS signal dropout over oceanic routes causes ETA gaps; fallback to secondary radar feed introduces 15-min lag and degrades conflict detection accuracy

l4_steps.name: Confirm or revise gate assignments from updated ETAs
l4_steps.input: Updated ETAs, current gate occupancy status in AMS
l4_steps.output: Confirmed or revised gate assignment; conflict alert generated if overlap detected
l4_steps.kpi: Gate confirmed ≥60 min before scheduled arrival; <5% of gates reassigned day-of
l4_steps.pain_point: A single wide-body delay cascades into 3+ narrow-body gate conflicts as sequential turns are displaced — AMS does not auto-resolve cascades, requiring manual controller intervention

l4_steps.name: Notify ground handling of confirmed gate assignments
l4_steps.output: Notifications dispatched to ground handler, fueller, caterer, and crew bus scheduler
l4_steps.kpi: Notification sent ≥45 min before arrival; stakeholder acknowledgement rate ≥95%
l4_steps.pain_point: Multiple ground handling subcontractors operating on different messaging platforms (SITA, WhatsApp, VHF radio) — fragmented comms increase risk of missed gate changes

l4_steps.name: Detect gate conflict from delay or early arrival
l4_steps.input: Real-time gate occupancy data, inbound ETA stream
l4_steps.output: Conflict alert with affected flight pair, overlap duration, and time to arrival
l4_steps.kpi: Conflict detected ≥45 min before arrival; 0 aircraft held on apron >15 min due to gate unavailability
l4_steps.pain_point: Default AMS conflict alerting threshold is 10 min — fails to catch rolling delay sequences that compound over a 3-hour window at hub airports

l4_steps.name: Assess remote stand and bus bridge feasibility
l4_steps.system: SITA AMS + Ground Transport Management System
l4_steps.input: Conflict alert, remote stand inventory, airside bus availability
l4_steps.output: Remote stand feasibility decision with estimated passenger transfer time
l4_steps.kpi: Decision made within 10 min of conflict detection; remote stand option assessed for 100% of conflict alerts
l4_steps.pain_point: Limited bus fleet at congested regional airports makes remote stand assignment impractical for wide-body aircraft loads; no real-time bus availability feed integrated into AMS

l4_steps.name: Execute gate swap or remote stand assignment
l4_steps.input: Feasibility decision, available contact gate or remote stand ID
l4_steps.output: Revised gate/stand assignment confirmed in AMS and pushed to all connected systems
l4_steps.kpi: Gate swap communicated to all parties within 5 min of decision; AMS record updated within 60 seconds
l4_steps.pain_point: Gate swap triggers manual re-notification to 6+ parties (handler, fueller, caterer, crew bus, security, cleaning) — no single-button broadcast in current AMS configuration

l4_steps.name: Update FIDS, departure boards, and airline mobile app
l4_steps.system: SITA FIDS + Amadeus Altéa PSS API + A-CDM Portal
l4_steps.output: Updated passenger-facing displays and push notifications via airline mobile app
l4_steps.kpi: FIDS updated within 2 min of gate change; mobile app push notification delivered within 3 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Airline mobile app gate change notification requires a PSS API round-trip through Amadeus Altéa — up to 4-min latency under peak load causes passengers to board at wrong gate

l4_steps.name: Monitor aircraft block-on time and turnaround milestones
l4_steps.input: ACARS block-on timestamp, A-CDM turnaround milestone checklist
l4_steps.output: Real-time turnaround status dashboard with milestone completion percentage
l4_steps.kpi: Block-on captured within 2 min of actual; on-time departure (D0) ≥78%
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS block-on message can arrive up to 3 min after actual wheel-stop, distorting D0 measurement and masking genuine late-departure root causes in performance reporting

l4_steps.name: Validate all ground services complete before release
l4_steps.system: SITA AMS Turnaround Manager + Ground Handling System
l4_steps.input: Fuelling confirmation, catering upload complete, baggage loaded, cabin clean signed off
l4_steps.kpi: All services signed off ≥10 min before STD; late-service exception rate <3% of turns
l4_steps.pain_point: Paper-based sign-off by some catering subcontractors is not captured in AMS in real time — supervisor must chase confirmation manually, adding 5–8 min to gate release process

l4_steps.name: Authorise pushback and release gate in AMS
l4_steps.system: SITA AMS + Apron Control VHF Radio
l4_steps.input: Go clearance from all service streams, apron traffic status from Apron Control
l4_steps.output: Pushback authorisation transmitted; gate status set to Available in AMS
l4_steps.kpi: Gate released within 5 min of block-off; gate turnaround time ≤planned TAT per aircraft type
l4_steps.pain_point: Apron congestion at airports with single-taxiway layouts (common at secondary regional ports) delays pushback clearance from Apron Control, extending occupied gate time beyond planned TAT

l4_steps.name: Record and warehouse actual gate utilisation times
l4_steps.system: SITA AMS + AWS Redshift Data Warehouse
l4_steps.input: Block-on/off timestamps, gate occupancy records, planned vs. actual gate assignments
l4_steps.output: Actual vs. planned gate utilisation report loaded to Redshift
l4_steps.kpi: Data completeness ≥99% of movements; report available within 2h of operations day close
l4_steps.pain_point: AMS-to-Redshift ETL pipeline runs nightly batch — intraday utilisation analysis not available, preventing same-day corrective action on emerging gate congestion patterns

l4_steps.name: Analyse gate conflict frequency and root causes
l4_steps.input: Gate utilisation report, conflict log, delay attribution data from OTP system
l4_steps.output: Root cause analysis report with recurring conflict patterns and improvement recommendations
l4_steps.kpi: ≥80% of recurring gate conflicts identified with actionable root cause within 48h of operations day
l4_steps.pain_point: Delay root-cause data is siloed across SITA AMS, Amadeus Altéa PSS, and crew management system — manual correlation required; no automated attribution pipeline in place

l4_steps.name: Update gate constraint and master data in AMS
l4_steps.input: Root cause findings, updated aircraft type assignments, revised ground equipment specs
l4_steps.output: Updated gate constraint library effective for next scheduling cycle
l4_steps.kpi: Master data update cycle ≤7 days from change identification; 0 gate conflicts caused by stale constraint data in rolling 90-day window
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated synchronisation between airline fleet database (reflecting aircraft type changes) and AMS gate constraint tables — changes must be re-keyed manually, introducing error risk
